selection: First six filenames by SHA256 of vision-adaptive-stardist-v1: + filename, before downloading image/annotation archives
preprocessing: Fixed per-image percentiles 1/99.8, clipped and rounded to 8-bit, no spatial resize; all modes including standalone see the identical converted image
annotation_decoder: Connected components of equal values in RGB red channel, 8-connectivity, zero background, as official decoding example
primary_metric: Local derived count MAPE against annotation-derived nucleus counts; not the published BBBC039 segmentation benchmark metric
